methodSections.heading: Mornay
steps: Melt the butter in a sauce pan over low heat. Whisk in the flour and allow it to cook for 2 minutes while regularly stirring to avoid colouring.
Whisk in the cream and milk. Stir frequently for 15 minutes on a very low heat. Take off the heat, add the cheese and season.

methodSections.heading: Croque Madame
steps: Lightly toast the sourdough bread slices until they are evenly coloured, but not too dry.
Evenly spread the Dijon mustard on 2 of the slices and then layer the black forest ham and the Gruyère on top.

Spread roughly a tablespoon of mornay on each of the remaining two slices of toast and place mornay-side-down to close the sandwiches. Spread rest of the mornay on the top of each of the sandwiches and bake or use a toaster oven until the cheese in the middle has melted.
While baking the sandwiches, place a non-stick fry-pan over a medium high heat and make 2 sunnyside up eggs. Place the eggs on top of the sandwiches and enjoy.
